Audition Portable.name: Audition Portable
Audition Portable.summary: Audition Portable is a Korean PSP game by T3 Entertainment.

Invizimals.name: Invizimals
Invizimals.summary: Invizimals is a PlayStation Portable augmented reality video game developed by Novarama, and published by Sony Computer Entertainment Europe. It is a collectible creature game, and is bundled with the PSP's camera attachment on launch.
